topics.label: Lecture Introduction
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the topic of complement and sets expectations for the lecture.

topics.label: Foundational Principles of Complement
topics.groupedBecause: They provide an overview of the foundational architecture and molecular logic underlying the complement system.

topics.label: Complement Activation Pathways
topics.groupedBecause: They detail the distinct recognition pathways that initiate the complement cascade and converge to reach the activation threshold.

topics.label: Effector Functions of Complement
topics.groupedBecause: They detail the downstream effector mechanisms triggered by complement activation to eliminate pathogens.

topics.label: Host Regulation of Complement
topics.groupedBecause: It explains the regulatory mechanisms that protect host cells from complement-mediated attack.

topics.label: Clinical Complement Deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: It examines the distinct clinical presentations and disease phenotypes caused by deficiencies across the complement pathway.

topics.label: Pathogen Evasion of Complement
topics.groupedBecause: It describes the molecular strategies pathogens use to circumvent complement-mediated immune destruction.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: It marks the conclusion of the lecture and previews the next topic in the course.
